- summary: one or two sentences (at most 60 words) on where the conversation is now: what most posts say and where it is heading. No numbers: the write-up already gives the counts, the peak and the velocity.
- negativity_drivers: two to three sentences (at most 85 words) on what drives the negative posts; "No clear negativity drivers in the posts read." when there are none.
- themes: two to three sentences (at most 85 words) on the other themes (questions, technical discussion, jokes, defenses of Google, official responses, press coverage).
- Inline post links: when attributing a specific reaction, claim, or outlet/public-figure post in negativity_drivers or themes (and optionally summary) to one of the numbered posts above, weave 1 to 3 short inline references using [short phrase](#N) where N is the post's number above (1..4), e.g. "users criticized [the incident response](#3)" or "[SkyNews](#2) reported the outage". Never invent URLs or cite numbers outside 1..4.
